intro: The glossary is a collection of terms and definitions that your readers may encounter in the stories. Glossary terms can be linked from any text field using [[term_id]] syntax.
intro_instructions: Use the sidebar to browse and add terms. Click a term to edit its title and definition.
delete_term_confirm: Delete this term? Any [[term_id]] links in your content will become broken links.
empty_state: Define the terms in your stories
empty_state_description: Add terms your readers will encounter in the stories. Use [[term_id]] links in any text field to connect them.
kind_unknown: {{value}} (not a known kind, so the site shows it as "{{kind}}")
kind_error_id_required: Add an ID for this kind.
kind_error_label_required: Add a label for this kind.
kind_error_heading_required: Add a heading for this kind.
kind_error_values_not_list: Its other names are not written as a list.
kind_error_id_taken: The ID "{{value}}" already belongs to the kind "{{kind}}". Choose a different ID.
kind_error_value_taken: The name "{{value}}" already belongs to the kind "{{kind}}". Remove it or choose a different one.
kinds_intro: Every term is of one kind. The glossary page lists your site's own kinds after the standard ones.
kinds_none: You haven't added a kind of your own yet.
kind_field_id_help: The short name stored in each term. The site ignores capitals, accents, hyphens and underscores when it compares names.
kind_field_label_help: Shown above the term's title in the glossary panel. Write it in your site's language.
kind_field_heading_help: Shown over this kind's terms on the glossary page. Write it in your site's language.
kind_field_values_help: Other words you can write in the glossary sheet's kind column for this kind, separated by commas. The ID always works.
kind_id_change_note: Terms of this kind will change to the new ID when you save.
kind_remove_confirm_one: Remove {{label}}? Its one term keeps its kind as written, and the site lists it as {{default}} until you choose another kind for it.
kind_remove_confirm_other: Remove {{label}}? Its {{count}} terms keep their kind as written, and the site lists them as {{default}} until you choose another kind for each.
kind_remove_confirm_none: Remove {{label}}? No terms are of this kind.
kind_unusable_in_repo: The site ignores this kind as it is written in your settings: {{problem}} Fix it here and the site will use it.
kinds_saved: Your kinds are saved. They reach the site when you publish.
kinds_save_failed: The kinds were not saved. Try again.
kinds_conflict: Someone else changed the kinds while you were editing. Your changes were not saved. Close this window and open it again to see theirs.
rename_prompt_one: {{count}} link points to {{old}}. Update it to {{new}} too?
rename_prompt_other: {{count}} links point to {{old}}. Update them to {{new}} too?
empty_title: Define the terms in your stories
empty_body: Add terms your readers will encounter in the stories. Use <chip>[[term_id]]</chip> links in any text field to connect them.
address_shared_dropped: The site already publishes "{{kept}}" at this term's address, so it does not publish this term and links to it show as missing. Change this term's ID so it differs from "{{kept}}" by more than capital letters or punctuation.
address_shared_kept_one: "{{others}}" has the same address as this term, so the site does not publish it and links to it show as missing. Change its ID so it differs from this term's ID by more than capital letters or punctuation.
address_shared_kept_other: {{others}} have the same address as this term, so the site does not publish them and links to them show as missing. Change their IDs so they differ from this term's ID by more than capital letters or punctuation.
address_shared_marker: Shares its address with another term
address_shared_dropped_case: The site already publishes "{{kept}}" at this term's address, so it does not publish this term. Links to this term's ID open "{{kept}}" instead. Change this term's ID so it differs from "{{kept}}" by more than capital letters.
address_shared_kept_one_case: "{{others}}" has the same address as this term, so the site does not publish it. Links to "{{others}}" open this term instead. Change its ID so it differs from this term's ID by more than capital letters.
address_shared_kept_other_case: {{others}} have the same address as this term, so the site does not publish them. Links to them open this term instead. Change their IDs so they differ from this term's ID by more than capital letters.
